author: AtditC
body:
Hello Avicus Staff members!

Today a chat report:

Name of player being reported: cookiezac
Rule broken: Encouraging Suicide
Evidence: https://i.gyazo.com/9aa45994e7cf802f2829387b83f37ef9.png http://pastebin.com/bCsiB9UM
Anything else you would like to add? A junior mod who was the only mod online at this time said "be nice please" after cookiezac wrote "KYS KYS". Check the chat log for the next messages. I just think that a mod always should follow the punishment guidelines when it comes to "kys" in chat. (This is not a staff member complaint, only a report. I know where I could complain about staff members!)

Greetings,
-Atdit
